verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a self-hostable engine with strong deployment options. It ships as a single binary with no external dependencies that runs on Linux, macOS or Windows, and installs via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, source or Helm charts. Community users confirm easy self-hosted deployments, including k8s, Coolify/Docker and an 80M-document Hetzner box. However, feature parity with the hosted product is not established: the Cloud page advertises native clusterization for read high availability, and community users report the replicated/distributed version and HA are not in the free tier. Pricing-page features like personalization and dynamic search rules have no evidence of self-hosted availability. Missing for 10: documented parity between self-hosted and Cloud, self-hosted HA/replication, confirmation that analytics, personalization and dynamic search rules work self-hosted.
